ModMetaData.name: RimMT V0.9.3-T34C.7 Reuse-Gated Classification Kernel
ModMetaData.author: Allen / Rimworld-Project
ModMetaData.description: RimMT T34-C.7 for RimWorld 1.5. Adds reuse-gated candidate classification after runtime evidence showed that most classification plans were never consumed. The first observation of a source snapshot and kernel performs no fact capture or worker scheduling; only a repeated observation may build a plan. The authority-safe Refuel full-negative kernel, live state revocation, structural quarantine and Vanilla final authority remain unchanged. FullParallel remains HARD_OFF.
